item.text:
**Bottom line**
- 5B.8 is **mixed, leaning somewhat positive on intended redistribution, but with clear signs of patronage sensitivity and uneven treatment of vulnerable groups**.
- The strongest positive evidence is AMLO’s broad social spending, Indigenous-rights reform, and expanded health/anti-violence measures. The strongest negative evidence is election-timed cash-transfer timing, persistent discrimination against Indigenous/migrant groups, and abusive treatment of migrants and critics.

**Positive evidence**
- [Bienestar, salud, obras y basificación a personal educativo y médico, prioridades en último tramo de la 4T: presidente](/https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/bienestar-salud-obras-y-basificacion-a-personal-educativo-y-medico-prioridades-en-ultimo-tramo-de-la-4t-presidente/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-01-02  
  AMLO said the final stretch prioritized free universal health care, public works, and better status/pay for teachers and health workers. This supports broad-based distribution across classes and public-sector groups.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.6`

- [27-02-24 version estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](/https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/27-02-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-02-27  
  The government said it had invested in 6,611 health centers with infrastructure upgrades and equipment, especially in poorer areas. That is direct evidence of channeling gains toward under-served regions.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.6`

- [Reforma en materia de pueblos indígenas y afromexicanos es un acto de justicia social](/https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/reforma-en-materia-de-pueblos-indigenas-y-afromexicanos-es-un-acto-de-justicia-social/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-02-21  
  The executive-backed reform promised recognition of Indigenous and Afro-Mexican peoples as public-rights subjects, with self-determination, budget authority, consultation rights, and protections for women and migrant Indigenous communities. This is strong pro-fairness evidence for marginalized groups.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.6`

- [Se refuerza estrategia contra la violencia hacia las mujeres y niñas: SSPC](/https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/se-refuerza-estrategia-contra-la-violencia-hacia-las-mujeres-y-ninas-sspc) | SSPC | 2024-08-06  
  The federal government claimed a reinforced anti-violence strategy for women and girls, with outreach and training. Even if the feminicide drop claim is official and should be treated cautiously, the policy intent is distribution toward a vulnerable group.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.6`

- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay; debe más de mil 500 millones de pesos al SAT](/https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-03-15  
  The administration publicly pursued a tax-evasion case against a politically connected company. That is evidence against privileging regime-linked business interests.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.5`

- [Mexico and the U.S. agreed to coordinated steps to reduce irregular border crossings while protecting human rights](/https://theprint.in/world/us-mexico-to-clamp-down-on-illegal-immigration-leaders-say/2062785/) | Reuters | 2024-04-30  
  Mexico paired migration controls with explicit human-rights language, which is limited but real evidence of not treating migrants as expendable out-groups.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.7`

**Negative evidence**
- [Programas para el Bienestar: evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](/https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18  
  Welfare payments were advanced before the electoral blackout, which makes the timing look at least partly patronage-sensitive and electorally strategic.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.7`, `5B.5`

- [Ninguna forma de discriminación racial debe existir](/https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/ninguna-forma-de-discriminacion-racial-debe-existir?idiom=en) | Secretaría de Gobernación / CONAPRED | 2024-03-21  
  The government itself acknowledged persistent barriers such as racial profiling, arbitrary detentions, invisibility of Afro-Mexicans, and obstacles to identity documents for Indigenous, migrant, and ethnic-minority people. That undercuts a clean fairness narrative.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.5`

- [World Report 2024: Mexico](/https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024  
  HRW said migrants are preyed upon, checkpoints disproportionately affect Indigenous and Afro-Mexican people, and women with disabilities face disproportionate violence. This is strong evidence that gains and protection were not distributed evenly across groups.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.5`

- [Mexico's military role in migrant massacre comes under sharp scrutiny](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-2024-10-16/) | Reuters | 2024-10-16  
  Reuters reported soldiers killed six migrants. Even though this is a security event rather than an economic-policy item, it is direct evidence that a vulnerable group was not protected with equal regard.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.5`

- [AMLO frequently lambasted the INE and pushed an overhaul critics said could cement Morena’s political hegemony](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04  
  This is indirect but important: a political strategy aimed at entrenching the governing coalition weakens confidence that gains would be distributed without favoring regime supporters.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.5`, `5B.7`

- [AMLO’s judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-15  
  Critics said the overhaul weakened judicial independence and investor confidence. Weak courts make it easier for connected groups to capture benefits and harder for outsiders to contest unequal treatment.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, `5B.5`, `5B.7`

**Search gap**
- I found **good evidence on intended redistribution and protection of marginalized groups**, but **little direct 2024 evidence on actual regional/class incidence of income gains** beyond official claims.
- The record is also **thin on explicit favoritism to regime supporters in economic allocation**; the strongest signals are indirect, through election-timed transfers, institutional weakening, and patronage-prone political centralization.
